b.note: b-t is descriptive; the reading applies the t bars to b-a on all 117 items

definitions.t: SAM 3 tracker seeded with the bound GT instance on its first visible anchor, forward over the 32 served anchors; deployed bestspread lift and min-area fit (relift.fit_lift).
definitions.s: SAM 3 tracker seeded with the served mask on the deployed lift best frame (K1 S_A0 rule); same lift and fit.
definitions.share: (k-a)/(e-a): ratio of item means; interval from the ratio of the same bootstrap draws.
definitions.seed200: items whose every operand has a t seed with status OK and area_240 >= 200 (SEEDS_GTC); an operand without a t seed excludes its item; t-a with the same bootstrap.
definitions.reading: registered bars on t-a over all 117 items: >= 8 with lower bound > 0 -> source_once_seed_right; <= 4 with upper bound < 8 -> not_the_source unless the seed200 subset shows t-a >= 8 with lower bound > 0 (then undecided); otherwise undecided.
definitions.precision_recall: per (item, operand, anchor) with GT or prediction nonempty; precision mean over frames with prediction nonempty, recall mean over frames with GT nonempty.
definitions.b: SAM 3 tracker seeded with the bound GT instance on the anchor where its 240x320 area is largest (ties lowest), forward and backward over the 32 served anchors (K1 carry rule); same lift and fit; operands with no visible anchor keep empty masks.
definitions.b_reading: registered bars on b-a over all 117 items: >= 8 with lower bound > 0 -> source_when_seeded_on_best_frame; <= 4 with upper bound < 8 -> not_the_source; otherwise undecided (no seed-size guard). b-t is descriptive.
